correctness.rationale: The graph6 strings decode under the standard convention to five connected cubic 12-vertex graphs; source verifier performs exact Hamiltonian backtracking, automorphism and isomorphism search. Independent networkx graph6 decoding and bitset mod-two boundary ranks over all 4095 subsets reproduced all 15 face vectors/Betti profiles: r=1 circle ranks 6,6,5,6,4; r=2 2,1,1,1,1 second-sphere ranks; r=3 acyclic. The actual verify.py source constructs staged face-poset matchings, tests all Hasse covers and full acyclicity, yielding one critical vertex and critical cells only in one positive dimension, sufficient by Forman for asserted wedges. Distances are integral; all r>=3 stages contractible, including the r=3-to-4 interval of four diameter-4 graphs. Exhaustion depends on the published 5-of-80 count.

value.rationale: A complete finite natural classification of the five smallest asymmetric cubic Hamiltonian 12-vertex graph isomorphism classes under graph shortest-path Rips topology is an exact structural invariant, not a cherry-picked parameter. The five homotopy filtrations distinguish the first graph via the double 2-sphere and quantify circle ranks; full wedge types go beyond raw Betti tables. The exact class is motivated independently by Brewer’s enumeration.

limitations: Graph metric, inclusive thresholds and 12-vertex asymmetric cubic Hamiltonian class only.
